name: tft28_ili9341_xpt2046
title: 2.8-inch TFT on an ILI9341, SPI, with touch and an SD slot
description: A 240x320 colour display on SPI with an XPT2046 resistive touch on lines of its own and an SD slot on four more pins; a regulator makes 3.3 V from VCC
notes: The board is that of the schematic of lcdwiki for its MSP2807: the same parts by their names, Q1, U1, J1, U2, R1 to R6, and the same order of contacts. J1 is open for 5 V on VCC and closed for 3.3 V. The touch has its own clock and data contacts, T_CLK, T_DIN, T_DO, beside those of the display.

power.name: VCC
power.why: 5 V with J1 open, 3.3 V with J1 closed.

lcd.notes: LED switches the backlight through Q1, an S8050: high lights it.

sd.notes: CS, MOSI and CLK of the card go through 1 kOhm.

photo.notes: The silkscreen of the back: VCC GND CS RESET DC SDI(MOSI) SCK LED SDO(MISO) T_CLK T_CS T_DIN T_DO T_IRQ, and SD_CS SD_MOSI SD_MISO SD_SCK; J2 and J4 on the front, contact 1 of each on a square pad.

schematic.source: lcdwiki, MSP2807-2.8-SPI.pdf of 2019-06-15 (https://www.lcdwiki.com/res/MSP2807/MSP2807-2.8-SPI.pdf), for a board with the same parts and contacts; the size of the pixels is the active area of the page of the MSP2807. Not tried.

start.source: What an ILI9341 does with MADCTL 0 on a panel of 240x320. At which corner of this module the first pixel lies is not tried.
